articles.headline: UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava to undergo season-ending knee surgery
articles.description: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava will sit out the rest of the season for the ninth-ranked Bruins after learning he'll need surgery for a knee injury sustained late in the first half of a 17-15 win over Oregon, first-year coach Bob Chesney said Monday.
